map.name: Kelm
map.trouble: Vaskor the Necromancer has raised the drowned of Lake Kelm, his Zombies hold the lighthouse on Gull Isle and the lake road is shut, and he wants the Black Pearl the village keeps.

guard_bark.specifics: Torvik at the lake road gate, shut by Mayor Gundrel while Vaskor's Zombies walk the shore.

first.speaker: Torvik
first.text: You look handy enough. But that won't get you through this gate! Now move along!

again.speaker: Torvik
again.text: Stay right there, stranger! Mayor Gundrel has shut the lake road to all comers and his seal on this order says so! Turn around. There's a dry bed waiting for you at the Bent Hook! Will you go quietly, stranger?

later.speaker: Torvik
later.text: You talked the Mayor into opening the gate!? You're mad! Now go on through! Don't come crying to me!

bounty_offer.specifics: Mott, an old fisherman, pays a bounty on the Bears from the pine woods that raid his smokehouse.

offer.speaker: Mott
offer.text:
I'm the one paying the bounty on Bears this season. The brutes have raided my smokehouse 3 nights out of 4. You have to clear out their whole den to collect.

Every hunter gets a Bow from me. This one is yours. Carry it up to their den in the pine woods when you're ready.

reminder.speaker: Mott
reminder.text: Those Bears are the boldest and greediest thieves on all of Lake Kelm. Your trip to their den will show whether you're fit to carry that Bow of mine.

completion.speaker: Mott
completion.text: Thanks again Wanderer. You have done the whole shore a great service, one I won't soon forget. Here's your bounty.

journal.text: Clear the Bears out of their den in the pine woods.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Gisla, a fisherman's widow, lost her magic lantern to the Imps of the reed caves.

offer.speaker: Gisla
offer.text:
I've never set foot in the reed caves and can only repeat you the warning my husband gave me, long ago -- mind the deep water.

The Imps who live there stole my magic lantern off the dock. Will you bring it back to me?

refusal.speaker: Gisla
refusal.text: You don't have a minute to spare for a poor widow.

reminder.speaker: Gisla
reminder.text: My lantern must be down there somewhere!

completion.speaker: Gisla
completion.text:
Wonderful! Thank you kindly, young sir. I am truly amazed at your courage!

Now, you must take these Leather Boots.

after.speaker: Gisla
after.text: Thank you. I suppose you're not a stranger here anymore.

journal.text: Find a way to win back Gisla's lantern from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find a way to win back Gisla's lantern from the Imps.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: Brannoc on Vaskor, Dulcie mocking, Hobb and his nets.

rumour1.speaker: Brannoc
rumour1.text: I've heard that Vaskor the Necromancer has at last grown tired of hiding out on his island. He's raising the drowned for an attack on Kelm! We must all keep a sharp eye on the shore!

rumour2.speaker: Dulcie
rumour2.text: Row, stranger, row! Hah, hah, hah...!

shop_greeting.specifics: Bolo of the Bent Hook inn, Harg the smith, Odra who sells potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Bolo
inn.text: Well... Not the biggest inn on the lake exactly... But warm and dry all the same!

arms.speaker: Harg
arms.text: Sorry, I don't haggle with paupers.

magic.speaker: Odra
magic.text: Strangers aren't trusted here. But for a few coins more, I'll trust you just this once.

two_givers.specifics: Torvik sends the player to Fesk to fetch back Mayor Gundrel's toll box from the Zombies in the marsh, and Skiv the smuggler wants his crates hauled out of a cellar the Zombies got into.

offer_a.speaker: Torvik
offer_a.text:
It's a disaster! The toll box is Mayor Gundrel's pride and joy and the Zombies have carried it off into the marsh! He's shut his door and won't open it till the box is home!

A boatman named Fesk lives down on the south dock, past the inn. We need him to take you out through the reeds and bring back our poor Mayor's box.

offer_b.speaker: Skiv
offer_b.text:
There is a cellar under the old fish market where I keep my goods. Before the Mayor shut the market, it served as our best hiding place for ale casks and related cargo. It has a few hidden doors and a trap or two, which were put in to keep out the Mayor's tax men.

Now the Zombies have got in down there. Haul my crates out to my boat and I'll give you a Longsword for your trouble.

outcome_a.speaker: Gundrel
outcome_a.text: So much silver for so poor a village! Take a handful if you can!

outcome_b.speaker: Skiv
outcome_b.text: ...and now I'll just go and count my crates.

journal_a.text: Go to Fesk the boatman on the south dock.

journal_b.text: Haul the first load of Skiv's crates out to his boat.

rescue.specifics: Gilm begs the player to bring back Father Orrin, dragged into the Sunken Chapel by Vaskor's Zombies, who want the Black Pearl from him.

plea.speaker: Gilm
plea.text: The old hatred between the living and the drowned runs deep on this lake, lad. So go carefully as you climb down into the Sunken Chapel, because I doubt the Zombies will be glad to see a warm body. Bring Father Orrin home. Kelm is lost without him. Go on now... And watch your feet! Zombies love to grab a man from below!

reminder.speaker: Gilm
reminder.text: It's rare that a stranger comes to the aid of our village.

found.speaker: Orrin
found.text: My strength may be failing, but you'll never get the Black Pearl from me, Vaskor. There is another, wiser than me, who will stand in your way.

following.speaker: Orrin
following.text: Young sir! Please lead me out!

completion.speaker: Orrin
completion.text: Thanks for bringing me back. Take this Ankh with you.

journal.text: Follow the shore to the Sunken Chapel and find Father Orrin.

main_opening.specifics: Fesk points the player to Mayor Gundrel in the Town Hall, who sends him after Vaskor on Gull Isle.

herald.speaker: Fesk
herald.text: Vaskor must have found out how to wake the drowned. One night the lake was calm and the next the shore was crawling with Zombies! They want the Black Pearl. Go see Mayor Gundrel in the Town Hall.

opening.speaker: Gundrel
opening.text:
Emmerik told us to expect you. The people of Kelm have always been the keepers and faithful protectors of the Black Pearl.

Once Vaskor gets the Pearl the drowned will rise all over the lake, since the Pearl holds the greatest power in these waters -- far more than the old bones he digs up from the mud.

His Zombies hold the lighthouse on Gull Isle and the lake road is shut. Fesk will row you across. Stop Vaskor, lad!
